And if we can get it at 60% of that, we're very very happy. The second thing is we want the
combination of dividend income and expected per share value growth to at least match what we expect
for the S&P 500. (49:05) So if you say the S&P yields a little less than 2%, probably is expected to
grow earnings at 6 or 7%. We'd like companies where that combination is eight or 9% at a minimum. So
it could be an Altria that pays out a yield that's about 9% and isn't expected to grow earnings or
